title: Generated GEODATA OBJECTS callback allocation rollback and retry
scope: Direct AC1027 GEODATA DXF OBJECTS callback under dxfRW::write; one generated v2 GEODATA record, ASCII and Binary.
implementation: Added tests/geodata_objects_allocation_tests.cpp and a focused CTest target. The callback invokes the public dxfRW::writeGeoData API and propagates a refused record through the established writeRawDxfObject(nullptr) failure signal.

validation.perOffset: one-shot std::bad_alloc; failed write preserves destination sentinel and caller GEODATA state; same dxfRW codec retries successfully and fresh DXF readback matches typed fields

limits: Generated serializer transaction and readback evidence only.
Does not qualify a physical producer, GEODATA graph closure, native geospatial semantics, or broad support.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; test output uses its build scratch directory.
